description: 402 conformance and security check for an x402, MPP or A2A API: can buyer agents' SDKs pay it, and is it safe to pay? Checks the x402 requirements (amounts, addresses, EIP-712 domain, the same terms each time), that malformed and forged payments are refused, pay-to binding, MPP challenges, and the price against the Bazaar and openapi.json. Given an A2A agent card, it checks the a2a-x402 task flow. At 5 cents or less, one paid call also checks replay, mutation and no-store. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Failed calls aren't charged.
